title: Counselling for Family Members of Patients in Palliative Care
what_it_is: Counselling for Family Members of Patients in Palliative Care

sections.label: Palliative care team support
sections.summary: Palliative care providers have multidisciplinary teams that support patients and family members, including counselling, caregiving, grief and bereavement care.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Palliative care providers have multidisciplinary care teams that support patients on palliative care services and their family members.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These teams comprise staff with experience in counselling, such as medical social workers, counsellors or pastoral care staff.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The care teams will keep in close touch with family members, assess their needs and provide the necessary support for the patient and the family.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This includes support to help family members cope with caregiving and grief management, as well as bereavement care after the patient's passing.

sections.label: Counselling uptake not tracked
sections.summary: Counselling uptake is not specifically tracked as it is part of palliative care, and patients and families are made aware of it upon admission.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The uptake of counselling services is not specifically tracked because it is delivered as part of palliative care.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Upon admission into palliative care services, the patients and the family members will be made aware of the counselling services available as part of the holistic assessment in recognition of the patients' and the families' needs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For instance, at St Joseph's Home, counselling actually begins at the point of referral of a patient and the family members into palliative care.

sections.label: SHC community engagement partnership
sections.summary: A three-year partnership with SHC from 2017 to 2019 runs a community engagement programme to raise public awareness of palliative care and EOL issues.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For instance, we work with SHC on a community engagement programme.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have a three-year partnership with them from 2017 to 2019 on this community engagement programme to raise awareness among the public about palliative care services as well as EOL issues.
